info.title: Happengo API
info.description: Read API for map-first local events. ProblemDetails type values are stable codes. EventTag is the fixed tag vocabulary. Bearer tokens are validated against the configured OIDC authority.

get.summary: Friends of the caller, with the caller's private tags.
get.description: Requires authentication. Display name only. Email is never returned. Tags are visible only to the person who set them.

get.summary: Whether the caller has an active invite link.
get.description: The token itself is not stored and is not returned. Rotate or create to receive a new token once.

post.summary: Issue the caller's invite link when none is active.
Replace the caller's invite link. The previous token stops working.

get.summary: Display name of the person who issued this invite.

post.summary: Accept an invite and create a mutual friendship.
post.description: Accepting again is idempotent. A user cannot accept their own invite. An unknown token is 404.

put.summary: Replace the caller's private tags for one friend.

delete.summary: Delete the friendship both ways, and the caller's tags for that friend.

put.summary: Set the signed-in user's display name.
Set whether the signed-in user's friends can see their event attendance.

get.summary: Events in the map viewport that have not ended.
get.description: bbox is minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat (SRID 4326). Uses location && ST_MakeEnvelope. Unlisted events are never returned. At most 500 events, happening-now first, then start time. truncated is true when more events matched. tags keeps events that have any of the named tags. happeningNow keeps only events with start_at <= now < end_at. when is now (default), today, weekend, or next7days. timeZoneId is an IANA time zone used for local date boundaries (default Europe/Tallinn).

post.summary: Create an event and join as its owner.
post.description: Requires authentication. StartAt and EndAt are required; StartAt cannot be in the past, EndAt must be after StartAt and in the future, and the duration cannot exceed 7 days. The owner is created as attending. The server generates the event ID and share token.

get.summary: List events the caller owns or attends, including past events.
get.description: Requires authentication. Returns events the caller owns, events they are attending (including after the event ends), and events with an active request. Rejected and cancelled attendance is omitted, and other users' events are omitted.

post.summary: Rotate an unlisted event's share link.
post.description: Owner only. Returns the new plaintext token once; only its SHA-256 hash is stored. Rotation creates no attendance or invite grants.

patch.summary: Update editable details of an event owned by the caller.
patch.description: Requires authentication. Visibility and approval mode stay unchanged. Edits to ended events conflict.

post.summary: Cancel an event owned by the caller.

get.summary: Read a live unlisted event by its share token.
get.description: The token does not reveal public or friends-only events, and it does not reveal an event that has ended.

get.summary: One event the caller is allowed to read.
get.description: Hidden, unlisted (without being the owner), and ended events the caller did not attend return 404. The share token is not returned; only its hash is stored.

get.summary: List active public incidents in a map viewport.

post.summary: Join an event or request to attend.

get.summary: List pending attendance requests for an event owner.
Get the caller's attendance state for an event.
